In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)={x}^{2}$ and $v(x)=\operatorname{sech}⁡2x.$ 

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{({x}^{2})}^{′}\cdot \operatorname{sech}⁡2x-{x}^{2}\cdot {(\operatorname{sech}⁡2x)}^{′}}{{(\operatorname{sech}⁡2x)}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{2x\operatorname{sech}⁡2x-{x}^{2}(-2\operatorname{sech}⁡2x\operatorname{tanh}⁡2x)}{{sech}^{2}⁡2x} \\  & =\frac{2x\operatorname{sech}⁡2x(1+x\operatorname{tanh}⁡2x)}{{sech}^{2}⁡2x} \\  & =\frac{2x(1+x\operatorname{tanh}⁡2x)}{\operatorname{sech}⁡2x}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
